# Destination-restricted forward proxy for the legacy handbook origin.
http_port 0.0.0.0:3128

acl node2_client src ${node2_ip}/32
acl legacy_origin dst ${node2_ip}/32
acl legacy_origin_port port 8081
acl CONNECT method CONNECT

# Tunneling is never permitted, including to the approved origin port.
http_access deny CONNECT
# Plain HTTP is permitted only from node2 to node2:8081.
http_access allow node2_client legacy_origin legacy_origin_port
http_access deny all

cache deny all
access_log stdio:/var/log/squid/access.log squid
cache_log /var/log/squid/cache.log
coredump_dir /var/spool/squid3
